{"operationName":"GetAllPricing","variables":{},"query":"query GetAllPricing($productIds: [Int!], $journeyKind: JourneyKindEnum) {
  pricing(productIds: $productIds, journeyKind: $journeyKind) {
    ...PricingFragment
    renewalTotal
    __typename
  }
}

fragment PricingFragment on Pricing {
  total
  totalWithDiscount
  shipping
  salesTax
  subtotal
  discount
  lineItems {
    description
    amount
    amountWithDiscount
    isDiscount
    group
    kind
    product {
      id
      buyNow
      amountType
      amountValue
      dosageValue
      drugType
      drugClass
      supplyInDays
      daysUntilFirstRefill
      supplyInformation
      description
      instructions
      displayedName
      publicDisplayedName
      needsPrescription
      price
      ndc
      serviceLine
      specialtyProductCollection
      conflictProductCollections {
        id
        name
        productIds
        __typename
      }
      __typename
    }
    __typename
  }
  __typename
}
"}
